shortDescription: Create or Delete VLAN Interface configuration on AOS-CX

options.name: acl_direction
options.description: Direction for which the ACL is to be applied or removed.

options.name: acl_name
options.description: Name of the ACL being applied or removed from the VLAN.

options.name: acl_type
options.description: Type of ACL being applied or removed from the VLAN.

options.name: active_gateway_ip
options.description: Configure IPv4 active-gateway for vlan interface.

options.name: active_gateway_mac_v4
options.description: Configure virtual MAC address for IPv4 active-gateway for vlan interface. Must be used in together with active_gateway_ip.

options.name: admin_state
options.description: Admin State status of vlan interface.

options.name: ip_helper_address
options.description: Configure a remote DHCP server/relay IP address on the vlan interface. Here the helper address is same as the DHCP server address or another intermediate DHCP relay.

options.name: ipv4
options.description: The IPv4 address and subnet mask in the address/mask format. The first entry in the list is the primary IPv4, the remaining are secondary IPv4. To remove an IP address pass in the list without the IP address yo wish to remove, and use the update state.

options.name: ipv6
options.description: The IPv6 address and subnet mask in the address/mask format. It takes multiple IPv6 with comma separated in the list. To remove an IP address pass in the list without the IP address yo wish to remove, and use the update state.

options.name: state
options.description: Create or update or delete the VLAN.

options.name: vlan_id
options.description: The ID of this VLAN interface. Non-internal VLANs must have an 'id' between 1 and 4094 to be effectively instantiated.

options.name: vrf
options.description: The VRF the vlan interface will belong to once created. If none provided, the interface will be in the Default VRF. If the VLAN interface is created and the user wants to change the interface vlan's VRF, the user must delete the VLAN interface then recreate the VLAN interface in the desired VRF.
